snippet.title: Epic fight from the first level - Last Hammashan: Awakening of a Hero
snippet.description:
Epic fight from the first level - Last Hammashan: Awakening of a Hero

It is the first level and Adam hasn't yet found the Astrolabe, so his powers are limited to the main attacks. despite of that, the fight is epic.
